authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10066 mārayati explicitly gives the widespread mār- kill/strike verb, including western mārṇā and Hindi mārnā. Survey mar/mara/mariyo forms are ordinary inflections; the kill gloss distinguishes the transitive verb from the related die paradigm. Uncertain transfer between Indo-Aryan languages does not prevent this supported family link under the user’s preference.
